## Docs checklist

Every PR leaves the docs accurate enough to hand the project to a new developer.

- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` reflects what works now and what's next
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` has an entry for any non-obvious design choice
- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated if structure, tables or invariants changed
- [ ] `docs/CODE_TOUR.md` covers any new module or Haskell idiom
- [ ] `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` updated if setup, commands or env vars changed
- [ ] No real financial data in the diff (`scripts/check-private-data.sh --all` passes)
